GET TO KNOW YOUR NEW STORE

A little know-how while you wait.

What happens when the build finishes?

The progress card above will change to “Ready to explore.” Open your store or jump into the design tools. You can try it all before signing in, and your saved changes stay with this store.

What can I try before signing in?

Explore your store and try the product design tools, including artwork, colors and personalization previews. Ordering, sharing and inviting members unlock when you sign in and activate your store.

Will I lose my designs when I sign in?

No. You activate this same store, with your products and saved changes. You won’t need to start over.

Do I collect sizes, names or payments?

No. After activation, each parent selects their own size and color and enters their name and number on supported products. They check their preview and pay for their own order.

How do I choose the right gear?

Check each product’s fabric details and size chart. Print appearance varies by fabric and color. DTG prints have a soft feel, and some color softening after washing is normal. Follow the garment’s care instructions.

When will orders arrive?

Items are made to order. Allow 3–5 business days for fulfillment, followed by up to one week for shipping. These are estimates, so leave extra time before an event.

Can I come back later?

Yes, on this browser. Your preview stays available for at least 48 hours after it’s ready. Unclaimed previews are then removed during overnight cleanup. Activate yours to keep it.

Need a different store?

FROM IDEA TO OPEN STORE

A few steps. Then you’re ready.

The request takes about two minutes. Most stores are built in about fifteen.

  1. 01

    Tell us about your group

    Add your group name, logo, colors, and a few details. You don’t need everyone’s sizes or a collected payment.

  2. 02

    Review your store

    We prepare your storefront and branded products. Once it’s ready, review the gear and use Admin Powers to refine your designs.

  3. 03

    Share with your people

    Send your store link or invite members. Each person picks their products, chooses a size and color, and pays online.

  4. 04

    We make it and ship it

    Items are made to order and delivered directly to each buyer. Your store stays available for the next order, too.

GOOD TO KNOW

A few common questions.

Need help with an existing store or order?

Visit support →
Does a store cost anything to set up?

Store setup is free. Members pay for the products they order, with no minimum group order or upfront inventory to purchase.

Do I collect sizes, payments, or orders?

No. Each buyer chooses their size and color, enters any available personalization, and pays directly online. Products ship to the buyer.

Can I change products after the store opens?

Yes. Store admins can use Admin Powers to adjust artwork and colors, add more products, and change which products are available.

Can new members order later?

Yes. There is no group order deadline. Share your store with new members so they can order when they’re ready.

How long will an order take?

Allow 3–5 business days for fulfillment, followed by up to one week for shipping. These are estimates, so order early for a fixed event date. See delivery details.
